main_measure.name: mean next-bar return in-stretch minus out-of-stretch
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference > 0 with Welch t >= 2; reject if difference < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; needs >= 100 in, >= 100 out, >= 3 stretches

supporting_check.name: share of up next-bars in-stretch minus out-of-stretch

decided_by: Inconclusive: |t| < 2 for the in-stretch minus out-of-stretch mean next-bar return.
reading: In-stretch bars are forecast > 0 and out-of-stretch bars forecast = 0 with next-bar returns taken inside each window; the situation is a positive raw SMA spread with a long forecast; a distinct up-cross stretch is a contiguous run of positive raw spread within one window; the supporting check passes when its difference is positive.
